gen-gf-amita-montserrat: Amita writes its headings with a loose, hand-drawn warmth and rounded, inviting letters. Montserrat follows on a plain sans frame with oversized counters, so a long paragraph glides along like wire.
gen-gf-amita-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall on its high x-height, with wide-open e shapes and every stroke cut to one width. Amita is the loose, friendly hand here, while Satoshi does the quietly approachable work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-amita-switzer: Amita brings a soft, hand-drawn friendliness to the top, with rounded letters that stay inviting. And Switzer, a sans-serif of tubular, wire-like forms and a tall waist line, gives the pair its sharpest quality: a loose hand set against Swiss precision.
gen-gf-amita-work-sans: Hand-drawn and rounded, with a soft hum. Amita is best at looking relaxed and friendly in a headline, while Work Sans, set with a high mean line and c tips that keep their distance, is best at sounding modern and contemporary in the text.
gen-gf-angkor-gf-graduate: Heavy, stencil-like and commanding, Angkor spaces its tight-mouthed rounded letters far apart with a hint of modulation in the strokes. Graduate answers it with a pen line that holds one width, and its open letters.
gen-gf-anybody-gf-epunda-slab: Loud and distinctive, with gently flared curve ends. Anybody is best at making lowercase crowd up toward the caps, while Epunda Slab is best at dignified, classic serif text with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded forms.
gen-gf-anybody-gf-fauna-one: Bold in attitude, Anybody packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets its curve ends flare without touching. Fauna One is best at a literary, dignified reading, with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and a generous e.
gen-gf-anybody-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads as refined and editorial, with big counters in a tall lowercase and curves that keep wide, unclosed mouths. But the strongest quality is the jolt against Anybody, whose bold display letters crowd the caps and flare gently at the curve ends.
gen-gf-anybody-gf-graduate: Flared curve ends that stay apart, with a lowercase crowded up against the caps, make Anybody instantly distinctive in a heading. Graduate is the foil: a dignified text serif drawn with a pen-like line of constant weight.
gen-gf-anybody-gf-kadwa: Anybody packs its lowercase up toward the caps and flares its curve ends gently, so every heading looks bold. But the pair's real strength is Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height.
